summary.en: The Detective Boys are invited onto the yacht of a wealthy businessman in Shinta City. The owner's wife invites the group to eat on the boat with them. During lunch, the woman shows the kids two videos: one in which her husband is learning how to swim with the help of a kickboard and one in which the man has finally learned to swim. After a few hours, while playing the kids see the entrepreneur jump into the sea and drown. Victim: Koutarou Takiguchi Cause of death: Drowning When Koutarou jumped into the ocean, he suddenly was unable to swim and began drowning. He eventually passed away at the hospital.
